sections.title: Investment Recommendation
sections.text: Costco demonstrates durable business fundamentals through strong revenue growth, high return on equity, and a modest capital structure. However, the market assigns a premium valuation, as reflected by an elevated price‑to‑earnings multiple. Balancing the resilient operating model against the high valuation leads to a neutral stance.

insight.text: The company’s low leverage, reflected by its debt‑to‑equity ratio, provides flexibility to fund expansion and absorb cost pressures.
